description: This Java class 'TriggerImage' generates images of trigger signals supported by rusEfi, reading trigger data from a text file, processing wave states, and rendering visual representations in a GUI panel.

classes.name: TriggerPanel
classes.description: Custom JPanel subclass for rendering trigger information, including TDC position, trigger name, ID, and timestamp.

classes.name: Signal
classes.description: Data class representing a signal with a specific value and angle.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes GUI, processes command-line args, and triggers image generation.

methods.name: generateImages
methods.description: Reads trigger data from a file and processes each trigger to generate corresponding images.

methods.name: readTrigger
methods.description: Parses trigger data from the input file, creates wave states, and updates the GUI panel with generated images.

methods.name: readTrigger
methods.description: Reads individual trigger wave data from the file and constructs wave state objects.

methods.name: angleToTime
methods.description: Converts an angle measurement to a time value (simple cast to int).
